title: Carbon Dioxide Concentration in Rooms Occupied with People
description: Calculate the carbon dioxide concentration in a room filled with persons over time using the formula: c = (q / (n V)) (1 - (1 / e^(n t))) + (c0 - ci) (1 / e^(n t)) + ci

outputs.label: CO2 concentration in room (c)
outputs.formula: (inputs.q / (inputs.n * inputs.V)) * (1 - (1 / Math.exp(inputs.n * inputs.t))) + (inputs.c0 - inputs.ci) * (1 / Math.exp(inputs.n * inputs.t)) + inputs.ci

outputs.label: CO2 concentration in room (ppm)
outputs.formula: ((inputs.q / (inputs.n * inputs.V)) * (1 - (1 / Math.exp(inputs.n * inputs.t))) + (inputs.c0 - inputs.ci) * (1 / Math.exp(inputs.n * inputs.t)) + inputs.ci) * 1000000
